+                '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', '-C', 'INPUT',
+                '-p', 'tcp', '-m', 'set', '--match-set', 'admin_hosts', 'src',
+                '-j', 'ACCEPT', '--destination-port', '22',
+                '-m', 'comment', '--comment', 'Allow admin SSH',
+            ])
+
+    def test_match_set_inversion_and_flags(self):
+        for flags in ('dst', 'src,dst', 'dst,src'):
+            set_module_args({
+                'chain': 'OUTPUT',
+                'match_set': '!blocked_hosts',
+                'match_set_flags': flags,
+                'jump': 'ACCEPT',
+                '_ansible_check_mode': True,
+            })
+            with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command', return_value=(1, '', '')) as run_command:
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson):
+                    iptables.main()
+            self.assertEqual(run_command.call_args[0][0], [
+                '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', '-C', 'OUTPUT',
+                '-m', 'set', '!', '--match-set', 'blocked_hosts', flags,
+                '-j', 'ACCEPT',
+            ])
+
+    def test_match_set_requires_name_and_flags(self):
+        for options in ({'match_set': 'admin_hosts'}, {'match_set_flags': 'src'},
+                        {'match_set': 'admin_hosts', 'match_set_flags': 'invalid'}):
+            args = {'chain': 'INPUT'}
+            args.update(options)
+            set_module_args(args)
+            with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                    iptables.main()
+            run_command.assert_not_called()
+
